description: CUR-EDIT, variant: relationship violations through the recordset edit path. On CH (relation RelPC to PA): AddNew with CID 10, PID 99 and Update; then Edit of CID 1 setting PID 99 and Update; on PA: Edit of ID 1 setting ID 10 and Update, then Delete of the first row; after each call Errors, EditMode and the row state are read, a failed edit is cancelled; at the end PA and CH are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
